trailhead.label: Compatsch main gondola station and trailhead

cautions: ORMA hasn’t verified this route yet. Follow local signs.
The high meadow is exposed to sun and fast-changing mountain weather.
Keep dogs controlled around grazing livestock and follow posted local rules.
Carry water even though a trailhead fountain is listed.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
